description: This file contains functions related to legacy SD card upgrade procedures, including image verification, upgrade execution, and configuration file copying, tailored for embedded Linux or OpenWRT environments.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition table in the SD card image matches the existing device to decide on image upgrade necessity.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for SD card, including writing bootloader and partition images, depending on detected differences.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files from a specified backup location to the new system partition.
